behaviors.behavior: record_review_pass.py record rejects a --payload-file whose basename doesn't match its review-type's canonical name (exit 2, nothing written)
every canonical basename (self/spec/code/doubt/plan/external_code) is accepted by the validator; plan_internal (no payload kind) is never rejected
spec/code/doubt canonical names stay byte-identical to what the PR-review classifier's own anchored regex already expects
the SubagentStop salvage hook's own local basename mirror stays pinned to the shared registry
the salvage hook's canonical-named output round-trips end to end into record_review_pass.py record (producer -> consumer, not just the two dicts)
the salvage hook refuses to write (and never creates the run directory) when reviews.json is entirely absent at the resolved project root -- the wrong-tree guard added after Stage-3 doubt review
every SubagentStop hooks.json wiring for spec/code/doubt-reviewer still salvages into the correct review type's canonical file when driven as a real subprocess
the iteration-reviews.md SKILL table always restates the canonical basenames verbatim (drift guard on the prose an agent actually reads at runtime)

surface_verification.justification: Pure library/CLI-validation logic + SKILL/agent prose changes (canonical review-evidence basenames); no startable web/CLI/API surface to drive beyond the pytest suites already run at F0 (18 units, 18849 tests, 0 failures, 100% diff coverage on the 3 changed source files).
